alternative_fix_sites: junction/timetable.py::Timetable._invalidate (clear every kept listing, or also drop the next day's)
notes: A disruption of service day D drops the kept listings of D and D-1, but the after-midnight part of D's trips is shown in the listing of D+1 (connections() builds day X from service days X-1 and X, so the inverse is D and D+1). If the next day's listing was already built (a board or a plan for the early morning), delays, cancellations and reinstatements of the night trip stay invisible there. Needs: a trip running past midnight, a board or plan of the next calendar day, then a disruption. Same-day disruptions are fine (public test), and line summaries read stop times directly and are always right (decoy). Clearing the kept listings inside boards only fixes boards; the planner probe still fails.
